services.name: runner-unit-a-openai-audio-speech-kokoro
services.compose_fragment:
runner-unit-a-openai-audio-speech-kokoro:
    image: tztcloud/openai-tts-runner@sha256:b3f4417d966c1ccfcf930cb89b77d456517daedb4f4e2e88c5ac0e5bb5f30369
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CAPABILITY_NAME: "openai:audio-speech"
      DEFAULT_VOICE: "af_bella"
      DEVICE: "cuda"
      HF_HOME: "/models/huggingface"
      LANG_CODE: "a"
      MAX_QUEUE_SIZE: "5"
      MODEL_ALIAS: "kokoro"
      MODEL_DIR: "/models"
      MODEL_ID: "hexgrad/Kokoro-82M"
      RUNNER_PORT: "8080"
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: runner-unit-a-openai-audio-speech-kokoro-cache-models
        target: "/models"
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              capabilities: [gpu]
              device_ids: ["GPU-regional-5090"]

services.name: runner-unit-a-openai-audio-transcriptions-whisper-large-v3

    volumes:

      resources:
        reservations:

services.name: runner-unit-a-openai-chat-qwen3-6-27b
services.compose_fragment:
runner-unit-a-openai-chat-qwen3-6-27b:
    image: tztcloud/openai-chat-runner@sha256:769ae95e93cfd9df37d3c8173a52d9ea428ef6dd2b63c0d9300b7277ca190ed7
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      BACKEND_MODEL: "sakamakismile/Qwen3.6-27B-Text-NVFP4-MTP"
      CONTEXT_LENGTH: "8192"
      MODEL_ALLOWLIST: "Qwen3.6-27B"
      MODEL_DISCOVERY_RETRIES: "3600"
      QUANTIZATION: "nvfp4"
      REASONING_PARSER: "qwen3"
      RUNNER_ADDR: ":8080"
      SERVED_MODEL_NAME: "Qwen3.6-27B"
      TOOL_CALL_PARSER: "qwen3_coder"
      UPSTREAM_KIND: "vllm"
      UPSTREAM_URL: "http://runner-unit-a-openai-chat-qwen3-6-27b-engine:8000/v1/chat/completions"
      USAGE_FIELD: "total_tokens"
    depends_on:
      - runner-unit-a-openai-chat-qwen3-6-27b-engine
  runner-unit-a-openai-chat-qwen3-6-27b-engine:
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:07ea4e292adf3a26b05ac97114b28849cf4551a26beb1fbe7decd3842d752ed7
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: 1073741824
    command:
      - "sakamakismile/Qwen3.6-27B-Text-NVFP4-MTP"
      - "--revision"
      - "6f194695406a3bc88a00573187d5b2eecf984a99"
      - "--served-model-name"
      - "Qwen3.6-27B"
      - "--host"
      - "0.0.0.0"
      - "--port"
      - "8000"
      - "--quantization"
      - "modelopt"
      - "--language-model-only"
      - "--max-model-len"
      - "8192"
      - "--max-num-seqs"
      - "4"
      - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
      - "0.75"
      - "--reasoning-parser"
      - "qwen3"
      - "--enable-auto-tool-choice"
      - "--tool-call-parser"
      - "qwen3_coder"
      - "--speculative-config"
      - "{\"method\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":3}"
    environment:
      HF_HOME: "/models/huggingface"
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: "/compile-cache"
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: runner-unit-a-openai-chat-qwen3-6-27b-cache-compile
        target: "/compile-cache"
      - type: volume
        source: runner-unit-a-openai-chat-qwen3-6-27b-cache-models
        target: "/models"
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              capabilities: [gpu]
              device_ids: ["GPU-regional-5090"]
